Name: GLMsingle derivatives for SI-Neural-Computations
Funding: National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) R01MH132826

GeneratedBy.Name: GLMsingle
GeneratedBy.Description: Single-trial beta estimates generated from fMRIPrep-preprocessed functional data in MNI152NLin2009cAsym space. Functional images were spatially smoothed using a 4 mm FWHM kernel. GLMsingle was run with voxel-wise HRF fitting, GLMdenoise, fractional ridge regression, autoscaling, and conversion to percent BOLD signal. The public derivative contains Type-D HDF5 outputs for the main, sipsts, and tom tasks. Physics-task GLMsingle outputs are not included.
